summary: Frontend-only smoke + interaction test of the Coco AI landing page (Next.js prerendered). All requested UI/UX behaviors verified on desktop (1920) and mobile (390). Engine diagram renders 7 tiles + core on both breakpoints with the opposite variant hidden via CSS as intended. Market ticker, navbar (desktop + mobile), modules bento, how-it-works, signal terminal (live rotation with real HH:MM:SS times), testimonials, and FAQ (item-1 open by default, item-2 expands on click) all work. /login and /registration pages render with auth-card intact. No console errors, no page errors, no hydration warnings. No horizontal overflow at 390px.
critical_code_review_comments: Mobile menu <a> links do not carry data-testid attributes (nav-mobile-link-*). Not required by the current spec but recommended for future automated regression coverage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page is a static Next.js prerender. Engine diagram renders 2 variants (desktop grid + mobile stack), each with its own copy of engine-tile-* and engine-core testids; CSS hides one based on viewport, so tile testid queries return count=2 with exactly one visible. Signal terminal rotates rows every ~2.6s client-side. FAQ items are <details> elements; check .getAttribute('open') to test expand state.
verified_flows: Desktop engine-diagram: all 7 tiles + core visible, mobile variant hidden
Mobile engine-diagram: all 7 tiles + core visible, desktop variant hidden
Navbar links (5) href to correct #ids; nav-cta -> /login
Mobile toggle opens menu with 5 nav links + support + nav-mobile-cta -> /login
signal-terminal: 5 rows, top row changes after 3s, times are real HH:MM:SS, terminal-cta -> /login
faq-item-1 open by default; faq-item-2 opens on click; faq-support-cta -> https://t.me/Ayan_sx
0 console errors / 0 page errors / 0 hydration warnings
